title: Digital Cosmos Framework (DCF): pre-registered tests of iron-sulfur energy tiers and of nerve metal chemistry read from sequence
description: Research repository of the Digital Cosmos Framework. Pre-registrations with a SHA-256 ledger, frozen analysis scripts, committed tool outputs and grade outputs for: (1) the 3-3-4 ferredoxin ladder as a label-free energy-tier marker (Manuscript 1); (2) reading the metal chemistry of nervous systems (K, Na, Ca channels; Na/K, Ca, Cu pumps; iron hydroxylases) from mRNA or protein sequence, tested blind across animals (Manuscript 2). Not for medical use.
